title: True Mace
description: 3D spherical mace made out of small cubes
body:
## **True Mace**

Upgrade your Minecraft arsenal with a bold visual twist! This resource pack completely reimagines the standard mace by transforming it into a **fully 3D sphere**, giving the weapon a smoother, rounder, and more striking appearance. Whether you're exploring deep caverns or battling fierce mobs, this new design adds a fresh sense of weight and style to every swing.

### 🔍 **Inside**
- 🟣 **Custom 3D spherical model** replacing the vanilla mace
- ⚙️ **Smooth, polished geometry** for a clean and modern feel
- 🎨 **Thoughtfully crafted proportions** that maintain gameplay clarity
- 🎮 **Compatible with vanilla mechanics**—no mods required
- 🌟 **Optimized for performance**, keeping your game running smoothly
- 🧩 **Perfect for themed worlds**, fantasy servers, and aesthetic builds

### 🧭 **Made For**
This pack is made for players who want variety without overhauling the entire game. The spherical mace stands out visually while blending naturally into Minecraft’s world. It adds personality to your loadout, enhances role-play scenarios, and brings a fresh identity to one of the newest weapons in the game.

### 🚀 **Installation**
1. Download the resource pack `.zip` file.  
2. Move it into your `resourcepacks` folder.  
3. Enable it from Minecraft’s Resource Packs menu.  
4. Enjoy smashing mobs with your stylish new spherical mace! 🟣✨

### 📦 **Notes**
- Designed with compatibility in mind—should work alongside most other packs that don’t modify the mace model.
- Best experienced with default textures or packs that keep weapon colors close to vanilla.

Bring a new dimension to combat and let every hit land with spherical satisfaction!

### I don't actively update this project anymore, however any suggestions can be submitted to my [discord server](https://discord.gg/gEjJwKk8gs)
